# Awesome Weekend Repos

> Curated open-source developer tools, CLI utilities & weekend toolkits —
> each explained in under a minute. Curated and published by @weekendrepos
> on YouTube and Instagram.

## Links

- [Web Gallery](https://berkayturanci.github.io/awesome-weekend-repos/)
- [YouTube Channel](https://youtube.com/@weekendrepos)
- [GitHub Source](https://github.com/berkayturanci/awesome-weekend-repos)
